# TemporalBatch_Processing

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
A batching strategy that groups spike events across time steps to improve GPU utilization and reduce synchronization frequency. Optimizes the temporal dynamics of SNNs for parallel hardware, a key step toward real-time neuromorphic inference at scale.
